scope: finite authored computational integration experiment; no physical lab/customer validation

acceptance.model_faults: one dropped response before or after each physical command; reliable recovery operation only where supported

discovery_claim: Finite developer-authored policy grammar. Running selection produces executable policy data; not autonomous invention of that grammar. Both methods receive identical observations and prior known recovery methods.

cost_status: Authored whole-autonomous-service envelopes, not measured invoices or human hours. Includes failed search, construction, input specification, tool/inference/host use, verification, corrections, maintenance and support. Actual session model tokens and bills unknown; measured Python CPU is separate.
tax: 25% positive accumulated model income; authored sensitivity, not tax advice
financing_cost: 8% annual equity opportunity cost shown separately from accounting profit; all assets expensed immediately; no debt or depreciation
human_reference: 100% human workers with conventional software; 40-160 first-use engineer hours at authored fully-loaded USD100-200/hour plus identical compute, fees and support; hours unmeasured, includes ordinary automation
sample_rule: Exhaust all 6 declared interface families x2 sizes x2 target values x2 methods, retain all outcomes. K2 includes thresholds 7,31,58 on interval [0,64]. Development uses target 4, size2 only.
primary_metric: Accepted complete useful outputs, then complete modeled contribution. Economically material method gain requires equal acceptance and USD1000 lifecycle savings supported by measured resource differences; authored prices alone cannot qualify.
stopping: One registered finite matrix, no favorable reruns. Stop unsupported interface families; retain ordinary on tie. Model mismatch requires separate labeled development, not retuned confirmation. Global milestone unachieved.
largest_gateway: K1 128 samples x8 additions before confirmation, with actual funded late-bound artifact and independent native replay
scale: A separate 730-day conditional operating sensitivity at common day730, final complete [365,730) window; no aggregation of invented accepted native deliveries; no 3B claim from algebra alone
private_data: none; fresh simulation-only account authority stays local; public export cannot authenticate ownership HMAC
execution_revision_before_confirmation: Gateway development established only USD2849.85 first-order after-tax profit under stated costs, below USD3000 successor cost. Preserve gateway; add a separately accepted repeat K1 with all acquisition/production/support costs before K2. No cost or price reduced.
K2_information: Authored finite model, not blinded discovery: the measurement implementation has the declared threshold; controller receives measurement callbacks, not the threshold value. Both methods know the same response class.
evidence_role: finite_authored_comparison; source freeze precedes matrix; developer exposed grammar and one stale-readback development test exclude any blind/fresh-family discovery claim
capital_selection: USD25000 is the smallest registered whole-enterprise capital in {8000,25000,100000} above USD19700.20 first-delivery construction, acquisition, production and exposure requirement; unused buffer disclosed. No global financing optimality.
